specs.title: UAT-01 [FR-031/IT-026 F1 default] with the IME enabled the status bar shows the profile; F1 is taken by Programming IME only when AI is usable
UAT-02 [AT-010/ST-010] recognises .rs .py .tsx .ps1 .c; ambiguous .asm/.txt keep the current language and only hint
UAT-03 [AT-011/ST-010/IT-011] manual lock beats auto detection and is removable
UAT-04 [ST-006/IT-007/AT-026] candidates: Esc writes nothing, accept inserts exactly at the prefix, Ctrl+Z restores
UAT-05 [ST-007/IT-009] every profile returns its own candidates
UAT-06 [ST-043/AT-053/UT-024] machine code: verified bytes for known forms, no bytes for unresolved symbols, nothing executed
UAT-07 [FR-028/ST-021/IT-024] pause: no candidates, typed text never altered
UAT-08 [AT-023/IT-019/FR-022] with AI off, typing 100+ characters and pressing F1 sends zero requests
UAT-20 [FR-018/AT-018/ST-015] the key is stored only in SecretStorage: not in settings, files or logs; delete stops AI
UAT-21 [ST-014/AT-023/FR-016] consent is visible first: Cancel sends 0 requests; allowing sends exactly the authorised ones
UAT-22 [AT-033/ST-024] F1 shows both candidates independently and writes nothing until Apply
UAT-23 [AT-034/AT-036/ST-025/ST-028/IT-032] hunk selection, preview, apply as one undoable unsaved change; closing without Apply writes nothing
UAT-24 [ST-012/IT-014/IT-028] the request carries the UNSAVED buffer, not the disk text
UAT-25 [AT-037/ST-027/IT-031] editing while the model works: the old proposal is refused and the newer text survives
UAT-26 [IT-027] a failing whole-file request does not block the insert path
UAT-27 [AT-056/ST-042/UT-076] prompt injection in code and a malicious reply: nothing extra is read, sent, run or changed
UAT-28 [AT-050/ST-036/IT-040] secrets in the file: the user must choose; "Redact" sends no secret bytes and the proposal is restored locally
UAT-29 [AT-032/ST-023/IT-026] with the key bound to Ctrl+Shift+F1, plain F1 keeps opening the Command Palette
UAT-30 [ST-016/IT-017/ST-017/IT-018/AT-021] scenarios route to their own provider and key; effort is sent only when verified
UAT-31 [ST-018/IT-020/FR-023/FR-024] budget stops AI before any request; a 429 pauses AI; local candidates keep working
UAT-32 [ST-013/FR-015/FR-039] untrusted workspace: AI paths are unavailable and explained, nothing is sent, local candidates work
UAT-33 [ST-032/FR-044/UT-056] UI language is independent: zh-CN and ja-JP UI, the programming profile and code stay unchanged
UAT-34 [FR-016/ST-014] workspace authorisation can be revoked at any time and the next request asks again
UAT-35 [FR-025..027/ST-019/ST-020/IT-022/IT-023/UT-040] realtime AI: local first, AI marked as AI, stale/rapid typing never queues bursts, text never altered
ANN-10 with AI off nothing is asked, nothing is sent: the candidate is inserted unchanged (autoComment on by default)
ANN-11 default settings + AI configured: the whole file is sent after consent and the snippet comes back with detailed comments, code unchanged
ANN-12 if the AI changes the code, its comments are discarded and the original snippet is inserted
ANN-13 refusing the consent, or turning autoComment off, inserts the snippet unchanged with zero requests
ANN-14 a file with secrets is never sent for annotation
ANN-15 graph comment: Cypher block above the snippet, built from symbol NAMES of the folder (never their code), destructive statements dropped
ENG-01 [step 1.0] engine=rust without a usable core: clear status and notification, IME features off, no JS fallback, typing unaffected
ENG-02 [step 1.0] engine=rust: the core is killed while VS Code runs: status switches to "core unavailable", candidates stop, typing continues
UAT-42 [ANN-77] AI off: the annotate tab says so, nothing is asked, nothing is sent
UAT-43 [ANN-60] no selection inside a function: that function is the scope, the highlight shows it, and the hunks only add comment lines
UAT-44 [ANN-61] a selection: exactly the selected lines are the scope, whatever is around them
UAT-45 [ANN-62] Wider moves up the chain without sending anything; Generate then runs the wider scope
UAT-46 [ANN-69] Apply writes the selected blocks as ONE undo step: the code is unchanged, Ctrl+Z restores the original, the highlight is gone
UAT-47 [ANN-65] declining the consent sends zero requests; the tab waits and Generate asks again
UAT-48 [ANN-66] secrets: the request carries no secret byte, the comments read <redacted>, the secret stays where it was
UAT-49 [ANN-74] f1Mode=edit is the old F1: whole-file tab first, nothing starts on its own, Generate asks for both requests
UAT-50 [SEC-33] typing in a .env: never a dialog, ONE notification however much is typed, the status bar shows the lock; Allow this file opens it
UAT-51 [SEC-40] F1 on a .env: a modal with exactly Allow once / Allow for this session; Esc opens no panel and remembers nothing; Allow once is spent by one F1
UAT-52 [SEC-42] F2 on a .env selection: a refusal is a notice and the clipboard is untouched; allowing the READ does not allow the COPY (the content gate still refuses it)
UAT-53 [SEC-39] the command "Programming IME: Secret Files": allow the active file, see the decision, forget it, the status bar follows
UAT-54 [SEC-37] a name from programmingIme.secretFilePatterns is asked like a built-in one; the dialog says why
UAT-55 [SEC-30] a template and an ordinary source file are not asked: F1 opens at once, the status bar has no lock
UAT-56 [IT-006] the rule candidates reach the candidate overlay: source, language and order are the engine order, the text stays unchanged
UAT-57 [ST-008] the engine reads the syntax context: Rust statement vs expression, TSX vs TS, Python class body vs module level
UAT-58 [ST-031] the language drop-down of the floating candidate list offers the seven languages, the switch takes effect at once and the old candidates are not inserted
UAT-59 [IT-043] Assembly and Machine Code produce text only: nothing is executed, injected or compiled
UAT-60 [ST-009] PowerShell and machine code: only text or hex, zero execution and zero process injection
UAT-61 [ST-026] inserting/replacing Unicode at the caret: only the selection changes, UTF-16 and CRLF stay correct
UAT-62 [ST-029] a syntax error in the AI output is marked, the direct Apply is disabled and nothing is executed
UAT-36 [PRM-40] a prose selection + F2: the clipboard gets the improved 5W1H prompt (six headings in order) after a consent that names the receiver
UAT-37 [PRM-41] a code selection + F2: the request carries the whole file, the clipboard has the findings with their checked evidence
UAT-38 [PRM-42] nothing to optimise: a bottom-right notice with the right text, the clipboard unchanged, gone after the next typed character
UAT-39 [PRM-43] AI off: the UNREVIEWED template is copied with the reason in the notice and not one request is sent
UAT-40 [PRM-44] F2 without a selection is still Rename: our command does not run (no notice, no dialog, no request, clipboard unchanged)
UAT-41 [PRM-45] secrets: a high-risk file is never sent or copied without the user, "Redact and send" sends no secret byte, medium risk is redacted silently
